# browserify-sign

[![Build Status](https://example.invalid/travis/crypto-browserify/browserify-sign.svg?branch=master&style=flat-square)](https://example.invalid/crypto-browserify/browserify-sign)

A package to duplicate the functionality of node's crypto public key functions, much of this is based on [Fedor Indutny's](https://example.invalid/indutny) work on [indutny/tls.js](https://example.invalid/indutny/tls.js).
